"소속" refers to registration/ownership, not pickup/dropoff location. So there's no specific pickup or dropoff end. The location is a filter (대구 소속), not an end point. So 끝 is 없음.

So "주별 수입 최댓값" - this is grouping by week and taking the maximum per week. Then "가장 큰 값" - taking the maximum of those weekly maxima.
